messages:
Mia Chen: Quick async check — where are we with onboarding kumo-7b for the catalog launch? Need a short status: licensing, perf profiles, canary window, and any blockers. Target milestone: perf profiles finalized by EOD Friday.

Arjun Patel: Perf update: ran baseline CPU/GPU comparisons. Throughput looks fine but 512-token p95 latency is ~210ms higher than our SLA on A10G. Need to try kernel tweak + different batching.

Selena Rivera: Licensing: got the upstream author to sign the contributor license, but they attached a custom attribution clause. Legal needs to confirm compatibility with our catalog policy. I pinged legal earlier today.

Pat O'Neill: Canary schedule: can start a small traffic-shift next Tue if infra gives green. I blocked Tue 10:00-12:00 PT for the canary window. Will need a quantized artifact (q4/8) and the new KV-cache flush patch in runtime.

Arjun Patel: Action items for perf: 1) try fused attention kernel flag (--attn=fused-v2) 2) rerun with continuous-batching disabled to measure tail latencies 3) compare q4 vs q8 for latency/cost tradeoffs. Quick commands I used:
```
perf-run --model kumo-7b --seq 512 --batch 4 --attn fused-v1
perf-run --model kumo-7b --seq 512 --batch 4 --attn fused-v2
```
I'll post perf artifacts in the perf-bench channel after the runs.

infra-bot: CI pipeline for model-serve/kumo-7b passed unit tests (build 824). Docker image available: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/kumo-7b:staging-824.

Mia Chen: Legal pinged? Selena, do we have a change log for the attribution clause so we can surface it to customers if needed? Also who owns the model manifest/metadata PR?

legal-bot: Preliminary review done. Clause requires download-only attribution on model outputs — flagged as non-standard. @legal-team to confirm if acceptable; expect firm guidance by EOD tomorrow.

Selena Rivera: I added a short note in the model manifest draft: "attribution: author-required-download-notice" and linked the source. PR is under my name but Arjun has to land the runtime change first.

Arjun Patel: PR ping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/402 — contains manifest, perf profile metadata, and a small loader tweak. Needs one reviewer and a runtime owner to ok the KV cache change.

Pat O'Neill: Runtime change referenced: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/345 — please review. It introduces an explicit cache-flush when session tokens mismatch, and a flag `--kv-flush-on-change`. Tests added but we need a pair review.

Mia Chen: Owners: Arjun -> perf + runtime tweaks; Selena -> manifest + legal liaison; Pat -> canary ops + infra scheduling. If legal disallows the clause, we will either 1) ask author for an alternate license OR 2) mark model as "restricted" in the catalog (no hosted offering). Everyone ok with this contingency?

Selena Rivera: Fine with contingency 2 if legal says no. I'll draft a customer-facing note template in docs if needed.

Arjun Patel: Small blocker: quantized artifact generation on our buildfarm is flaky at q4 for this model — hitting precision dropouts on some tokens. I'll try q8 and a different quant library; will update by EOD.

infra-bot: Buildfarm job 5592 (q4 quantize) failed: OOM on step 7/12. Suggested retry on larger instance type (p4d or a10g-large).

Pat O'Neill: I can allocate a10g-large for a retry tomorrow morning. If q8 passes with latency within SLO, we can still do the canary and then iterate on q4 later.

Mia Chen: Ok — final ask: please drop concise status updates in this thread as you complete items. Arjun, post perf artifacts link. Selena, include legal summary once confirmed. Pat, confirm canary slot Tue 10am or call it off. I'll summarize for the cross-functional launch readout. :+1:

Arjun Patel: Will post perf artifacts (link) by 18:00 PT. PR 402 updated with perf metadata. (reaction :eyes:)

Selena Rivera: Legal should have a final answer by tomorrow EOD as legal-bot said. I'll post the manifest link and the draft customer note here after that.

Pat O'Neill: Confirming Tue 10:00-12:00 PT reserved. If legal blocks hosted, canary will be internal-only.

Mia Chen: Thanks — this is perfect. If anyone gets an urgent blocker ping me directly.

(THREAD END)
